# LocalDevVPN

Henge's optional loopback VPN (`ios/HengeTunnel/PacketTunnelProvider.swift`) is based on, and uses code from,
[LocalDevVPN](https://github.com/jkcoxson/LocalDevVPN) (formerly StosVPN) by the SideStore Team and Jackson
Coxson: its packet tunnel, which reflects the traffic for 10.7.0.1 back to the device. Only that tunnel is used,
not the app. Its license is in [LICENSE](LICENSE).
